# GMEOW Profile Meta-pattern Module

The GMEOW Profile Meta-pattern Module — classes, properties, and individuals of the GMEOW super-vocabulary.

**IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/slices/profiles>  
**CURIE:** `gmeow:slices/profiles`
